The Aqua Kitten Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Peel-Off Mask gifted by I Dew Care is a multi-functional skincare product that blends hydration, exfoliation, and a sensorial experience into one. Designed with hyaluronic acid, a powerhouse humectant known for its ability to draw and retain moisture, this mask provides an intense hydrating boost to parched skin. Unlike traditional peel-off masks that can feel stripping, this formula aims to be gentle yet effective, removing impurities while reinforcing the skin's moisture barrier. Its iridescent blue hue adds a playful and luxurious element, making it an engaging self-care ritual rather than just another skincare step. The gel texture spreads easily, forming a smooth, flexible layer that peels off effortlessly, revealing soft, supple, and refreshed skin. Ideal for those battling dehydration, dullness, or uneven texture, it provides an instant plumping effect without excessive dryness

It was fun. I liked the blue raspberry scent. The mermaid color is beautiful. My skin sparkled like a disco ball. I would do a thin layer of mask and leave it in for at least 30 minutes. Check everywhere to make sure it is completely dry. Mine was not completely dry and didn't peel very well. Afterwards I had lots of glitter on my face. I was able to wash and wipe most of it off but I am still sparkling. It feels a little hydrated. The cake may day mask is more hydrating. Definitely use a brush or spatula to apply this. Gifted by idewcare

avis.titre: My face loves skincare with hyaluronic acid
avis.texte: Yes, I love it because it is so satisfying to peel off and makes my skin feel hydrated. Honestly, I dont like the paper fiber face masks to treat myself, but this is different. It feels like I'm pampering my self, rather than having a wet piece of paper on my face. I received this product complimentary from I Dew Care.

avis.titre: Hard to Peel, But Very Cute!
avis.texte: This is the cutest! I love a blue mask, and the shimmer is so fun. I really love the vibe this brings to spa night! The only issue is that this is pretty difficult to peel off— it's not one easy sheet. Still, happy to have gotten this gifted by I Dew Care!

love love this!! It feels very hydrating on my skin and I don't usually use face masks… but this really is good. I was gifted by idewcare, getting the product for free and I am so glad I got to use it. Plus the packaging is cute!

I Dew Care Aqua Kitten peel-off mask is a water-based, gel-like formula that is infused with real cat ear-shaped konjac sponges. The mask is designed to be fun and playful, while also delivering a serious skincare treatment. Gifted by I dew care

Complimentary from idewcare! This mask is so fun and hydrating. I have used idewcare products in the past but this might be one of my favorites yet. my skin feels nourished and plump after use and the smell is non irritating.

This was gifted by I Dew Care. This mask left my skin feeling incredibly refreshed and moisturized. The texture is smooth, making it a treat to apply. It dries quickly, and after just a few minutes, my skin felt plump and hydrated without any greasy residue. Perfect for anyone with dry or tired skin, this mask provides an instant boost of hydration. I love how soft and dewy my skin looks afterward! Highly recommend it for a quick, pampering skincare session.

avis.titre: Fun and pretty color to use and hydrating too
avis.texte: The Aqua Kitten Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Peel-Off Mask is such a fun and pretty mask to use! I love how smooth it applies and the gorgeous glittery effect makes it even more enjoyable. The vibrant color is something I truly adore, adding to the excitement of my skincare routine. However, if you're sensitive to fragrance, this might not be the best fit, as the scent is a bit strong I personally wish it were a bit more subtle. The cooling sensation it gives after applying is so refreshing, and once it dries, peeling it off is both easy and satisfying. I love how hydrating this mask is, and the gentle peeling action doesn't feel harsh or stripping on my skin. It leaves my face feeling soft, refreshed, and glowing. Overall, I really enjoyed this mask and would definitely use it again!gifted by idewcare

Gifted by I Dew Care. I recently tried I Dew Care's Aqua Kitten Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Peel-Off Mask, and I'm genuinely impressed! The vibrant blue formula is fun to use and feels incredibly refreshing on the skin. It applies smoothly, dries evenly, and peels off without any discomfort. The combination of hyaluronic acid, Jeju sea water, and squalane makes a noticeable difference—my skin felt deeply hydrated, softer, and had a natural, dewy glow right after use. It's perfect for anyone dealing with dryness or dullness. Plus, the cooling sensation is a nice bonus! If you're looking for a hydrating peel-off mask that actually works, this one is definitely worth trying. Highly recommend!

This peel-off mask is a fun and effective way to boost hydration. The hyaluronic acid deeply moisturizes, leaving the skin soft and plump. The formula is easy to apply and dries evenly, making removal smooth without irritation. Plus, the shimmering blue color adds a playful touch to any skincare routine! Gifted by idewcare

This mask hydrates the skin without irritation, promotes skin strength and elasticity, and prevents moisture loss. It contains hyaluronic acid to hydrate and plump the skin, peeling away to reveal smoother, brighter skin. I will continue to use it and would definitely recommend it to my friends. I received this product complimentary from idewcare in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Fun mask for all kids and adults!
avis.texte: The I Dew Care Aqua Kitten Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Peel-Off Mask has a fun blue color and a smooth gel texture. It contains hyaluronic acid for hydration and blueberry extract for antioxidant benefits. Application is easy, but the key is to apply a thin layer and let it fully dry before removing it. Once dried, it leaves the skin feeling soft and refreshed. The hydration is more of a surface-level effect rather than deep moisture, so it's a fun mask for a quick refresh but not a replacement for a hydrating cream. Also, if you have sensitive skin, patch-testing is a good idea since peel-off masks can sometimes cause irritation. Gifted by idewcare

I received the Aqua Kitten Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Peel-Off Mask complimentary from I Dew Care for my review. This mask is a gorgeous iridiscent blue that was easy to apply and felt great on my skin. I love how the hyaluronic acid and squalane provides hydration and moisture while boosting skin strength and elasticity!

I received this complimentary from I dew care for my honest review. This mask spreads on very easy and after drying peeled off nicely. It is a great mask for hydration. I like it on my dry patches it really is soothing

Absolutely love this hyaluronic acid peel-off mask! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly hydrated, smooth, and refreshed. Peeling it off is so satisfying, and my face looks brighter and more radiant after every use. Gifted by I dew Care

The I Dew Care Aqua Kitten Peel-Off Mask is a fun and hydrating treatment that leaves skin feeling soft and supple. Formulated with hyaluronic acid, Jeju sea water, and squalane, this luminous blue mask aims to reveal a glowing complexion. While the peel-off application can be a bit messy and the light, sweet scent might not appeal to everyone, many users report a noticeable brightening effect. It's gentle enough for all skin types, even sensitive skin, making it a worthwhile option for those seeking an affordable boost of hydration. However, results may vary, and it's important to apply a generous, even layer, allow it to dry completely, and peel gently. Overall, the Aqua Kitten Peel-Off Mask is a decent choice for a fun and hydrating at-home facial, available at most beauty retailers. Gifted by aqua kitten

So this might actually be the most beautiful product I've ever seen! When I opened up the jar, it seriously was the most magical luminous sparkly blue swirl of color ever! I got soooo excited to try it out and it was really fun to dip into and apply to my face. The product definitely feels hydrating and I was able to spread it easily over my face. I waited till it dried before peeling it off which was also pretty fun! 10/10 super fun face mask that I can't wait to show my friends! Gifted by idewcare

If you're looking for a mask that adds a touch of playful joy to your skincare routine while providing a boost of hydration, Aqua Kitten is a must-try! It's the perfect pick-me-up for a dull day. Gifted by I Dew Care.

Nice packaging it smells like your typical face mask & easy to use. I noticed applying a thinner layer is a faster drying time about 15 minutes max. And the face mask left my skin feeling moisturized. Complimentary from idewcare

Gifted by idewcare. I've been using the Aqua Kitten Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Peel-Off Mask by I Dew Care, and it has quickly become a favorite in my skincare routine. From the moment I applied it, I could feel its cooling and hydrating effects, thanks to the hyaluronic acid. The formula is lightweight, spreads evenly, and dries down comfortably without feeling tight or irritating. Once it's fully set, peeling it off is super satisfying—it comes off cleanly without any painful tugging or residue left behind. After each use, my skin feels incredibly soft, plump, and refreshed. Beyond its skincare benefits, the mask also adds a fun and luxurious touch to self-care, with its shimmery blue formula making the experience even more enjoyable. I also love that it's gentle on my sensitive skin, as I didn't experience any redness or breakouts after use. The only minor downside is that if you apply a thick layer, it can take a little longer to dry, but that's easily manageable. Overall, this mask is a perfect blend of hydration and self-care, making it a great addition to any skincare routine. If you're looking for a refreshing, non-drying peel-off mask that leaves your skin feeling smooth and nourished, I highly recommend giving this one a try!
